name: Stratified-Time Conditional G/F Resampling
lineage_evidence: RELATED_MULTI_ALGORITHM_TERMINAL:selective post-D/E two-view G/F mean is the supported gain source
TERMINAL_AUDIT_ROUTE1_5090:time-stratum gradients are heterogeneous but terminal singular drift lacks cross-lane/domain support
ANTITHETIC_GAUSSIAN_GRADIENT_AUDIT:fixed sign involution is inferior to iid pairing and is not reused

compared_implementations: Gaussian antithetic endpoint and gradient constructions
prior_equivalence_audit.material_difference: ST-CGR preserves the native uniform discrete bridge-time marginal in each replica and changes only the coupling between the two post-D/E G/F time indices from iid-with-replacement to an ordered uniform pair without replacement. PTQ changed the marginal measure; antithetic constructions coupled latent signs; Proposal/HJCGR permit duplicate time strata.

unsb_object: the bridge-time component of the post-D/E conditional stochastic G/F gradient estimator under the native uniform five-index UNSB measure
formula: Condition on the current post-D/E state and official unpaired batch. Draw I1 uniformly from {0,...,T-1}; draw I2 uniformly from the remaining T-1 indices; draw all non-time randomness independently within each view; commit ghat=(G(I1,xi1)+G(I2,xi2))/2 once through the unchanged G/F Adam optimizers.
identity_or_unbiased_condition: Both I1 and I2 have the exact uniform native marginal, hence E[ghat|state,batch]=T^{-1} sum_t E[G_t]. Let Sigma_bar be the mean within-time covariance and V_mu the covariance of the time-conditional means using denominator T. Then Cov(ghat)=Sigma_bar/2+(T-2)V_mu/(2(T-1)), whereas the iid Proposal pair has Sigma_bar/2+V_mu/2. Their difference is V_mu/(2(T-1)), positive semidefinite. If all time-conditional means coincide the covariance is identical; disabling ST-CGR dispatches plain UNSB exactly.
target_inaccessibility_proof: The coupling reads only the first native bridge-time index and T. It never reads a paired target, domain label, image-quality metric, discovery result or confirmation sample. The no-diagonal rule and arithmetic mean are fixed before experiments.

expected_applicable_state.condition: two-view conditional G/F variance reduction is already beneficial and bridge-time conditional gradient means differ materially
expected_applicable_state.self_null_state: when time-conditional gradient means coincide, ST-CGR has exactly the same covariance as the iid pair; route1_stcgr_enable=false is exact plain identity
expected_applicable_state.known_limit: without-replacement coupling does not reduce the expected within-time covariance term and must be killed if fixed-state vector audits show a negligible between-time component

falsifying_experiment: Before any long run, reject the mechanism if exhaustive marginal tests fail, zero-intervention differs from plain, full-state resume is not exact, or the preregistered fixed-state gradient-vector audit on Proposal/HJCGR e60/e100/e150/e200 states fails. A full gate uses eight native stochastic gradients per bridge-time stratum on one fixed official unpaired batch after one native D/E commit. For each parent lane, the pooled bias-corrected Euclidean without-replacement/iid pair-mean covariance-trace ratio must be at most 0.95, every checkpoint must be noninferior within numerical tolerance, and at least two of four checkpoints must individually reach 0.95. Adam-metric geometry is diagnostic, not an alternate rescue gate. Paired PSNR is unavailable to this gate.

fixed_state_gate.state_boundary: after one native D/E commit and before the G/F commit

compute_cost: the same two post-D/E G/F views as Proposal-only; no extra network evaluation relative to that parent and approximately twice native G/F compute
memory_cost: unchanged from Proposal-only because the two graphs are materialized and accumulated in the same serial order
recovery_state_cost: ordered-pair and marginal diagnostic counts plus the ordinary full RNG state; no network, teacher or optimizer is added

ablation_definitions.proposal_only: ST-CGR on the native Proposal-only post-D/E G/F estimator while D/E remain one-view native.
ablation_definitions.observable_only: At frozen checkpoints, compare iid and without-replacement two-view gradient vectors without committing either branch.
ablation_definitions.projected_or_full: The complete ST-CGR estimator after the fixed-state target-blind gate; no projection or auxiliary loss is added.

unbiased_proof: The ordered support contains every (i,j), i!=j, with probability 1/[T(T-1)]. Each index occurs T-1 times in either coordinate, so each replica marginal is 1/T. Conditional linearity gives the native mean. Finite-population covariance gives a positive-semidefinite reduction V_mu/[2(T-1)] relative to iid pairing.
